sources.title: Samvardhana Motherson to acquire 50.1% stake in Rotary Connectors via arm at Rs 500 crore enterprise value

synopsis: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Samvardhana Motherson Adsys Tech Limited, will acquire a 50.1 percent equity stake in Rotary Connectors Private Limited. The transaction values Rotary Connectors at an enterprise value of Rs 500.4 crore, with the final equity value to be determined by adding net cash as of March 31, 2026, and adjusting for leakage or cash withdrawals. Rotary Connectors' existing promoters will retain the remaining 49.9 percent stake. The acquisition will be funded through cash consideration and is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of the financial year 2026 to 2027, subject to the completion of agreed conditions precedent.
